conditional_source_leads.condition: Declared smoke travel towards west versus east
conditional_source_leads.account: Westward smoke is associated with goodweather being past;eastward with goodweather coming next.
conditional_source_leads.limit: Travel direction,not automatically wind source direction;no horizon/date conversion oractual forecast.

conditional_source_leads.condition: Continued southerly wind versus light southerly wind five/six days after previously strong southerly wind
conditional_source_leads.account: Wing1649 associates continued south wind withrain;the separately attributed Texas case associates the qualified light-wind sequence withfine weather.
conditional_source_leads.limit: Different regional/contextual accounts;do not erase temporal qualifiers orpretend these are universally contradictory orvalidated.

conditional_source_leads.condition: User-selected hake-shaped cloud with east-west versus north-south axis
conditional_source_leads.account: Rain versus more fine weather,respectively,in the collected account.
conditional_source_leads.limit: Shape axis,not cloud motion/heading. No automatic identification oruniversal animal symbolism.

conditional_source_leads.condition: Light fleecy clouds moving rapidly below compact dark cirro-stratus
conditional_source_leads.account: Collected account associates the combination withrain near at hand.
conditional_source_leads.limit: Shape/texture,motion andvertical relation are all material;no numeric speed/height threshold orforecast deadline invented.

conditional_source_leads.account: Collected nautical saying counsels reduced sail,withmarginal wind indication.
conditional_source_leads.limit: Do not reduce the combination to any single cloud orissue navigational advice fromsoftware.

conditional_source_leads.condition: Mackerel sky in several separately collected accounts
conditional_source_leads.account: Accounts include fair thatday/rain one or two days later,more wet than dry,balanced wet/dry language,andnot24hours dry.
conditional_source_leads.limit: Preserve distinct worded horizons anddisagreement;no majority vote,confidence score,selected time orcalendar forecast.
